metadata.title: fix(ui): populate issuer field when editing OAuth gateway
metadata.author: kimsehwan96

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #3755

---

## 📝 Summary
The editGateway() function populates all OAuth config fields (client_id, token_url, authorization_url, redirect_uri, scopes) but omits the issuer field. This causes the issuer to be silently dropped when saving, breaking OAuth flows that depend on it.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
Good catch — the missing issuer field population was causing it to be silently dropped on save, breaking OAuth flows that depend on it (e.g. DCR).

I rebased onto main and added two follow-up commits on top of yours:

1. **A2A agent same-bug fix + tests** — the `editA2AAgent()` function had the identical omission. Added `id="oauth-issuer-a2a-edit"` to the HTML template and the corresponding JS population. Strengthened existing backend tests to verify all OAuth fields (`issuer`, `token_url`, `authorization_url`, `redirect_uri`, `client_id`) round-trip through form assembly for both gateways and A2A agents.

2. **Stale field value fix** — all OAuth field guards used `if (field && config.value)` which only sets the field when truthy. When reusing the edit modal for an entity without a particular field, the old value would persist. Changed all assignments to `config.value || ""` so fields are always cleared.

commits.message:
fix(ui): clear stale OAuth fields when editing gateways and A2A agents

All OAuth field population guards used `if (field && config.value)`
which only sets the field when the value is truthy. When reusing the
edit modal for a different entity that lacks a particular OAuth field,
the previous value would persist and be silently resubmitted on save.

Change all OAuth field assignments to unconditionally set the value
with a fallback to empty string (e.g. `config.issuer || ""`), matching
the pattern already used by oauthClientSecretField.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
